title: Mill & Pave in Emerald Hills
description:
Our Transportation Department is on track to resurface 30 lane miles this year, the most ever completed by the City’s in‑house Mill and Pave team. Mayor Todd Gloria and Councilmember Henry L. Foster III joined City crews on 51st Street in Emerald Hills today to recognize the milestone. 
 
Today, crews completed the milling work, grinding off the old asphalt to expose the base. The resurfacing team will return tomorrow for paving, which lays a fresh new layer of asphalt for a smoother, safer street. 

Read more about the work: insidesandiego.org/house-resurfacing-crews-pave-record-mileage-single-year
